CDM BA Principal Designer - CDM Bakerhicks Project Delivery - Utilities & Renewables 4 hours Project Delivery - Utilities & Renewables 4h At BakerHicks, we’ve grown rapidly in the Transmission & Distribution sector over the last 12 years, delivering projects that make a real difference to communities across the UK. As our portfolio expands, we’re excited to welcome Principal Designer - CDM who share our passion for collaboration, innovation, and creating a sustainable future. Role Overview We are seeking an experienced and proactive SR188 Principal Designer Representative (PDR) to support the delivery of a diverse portfolio of National Grid projects across both Front-End Engineering Design (FEED) and construction stages . Acting on behalf of the Principal Designer under National Grid’s SR188 framework, you will play a key role in ensuring compliance with CDM Regulations 2015 , driving high standards of health, safety, and risk management throughout the project lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Act as the Principal Designer Representative (PD R) in accordance with National Grid’s SR188 requirements. Support and advise clients, designers, and project teams on CDM compliance , including roles, duties, and documentation. Coordinate and manage design risk management processes , ensuring hazards are identified, eliminated, or reduced through design. Facilitate and lead design risk workshops , HAZID/HAZOP sessions, and design reviews. Ensure production and maintenance of key CDM deliverables, including: Design Risk Registers Pre-Construction Information (PCI) Health and Safety Files Provide CDM and safety input, influencing safe-by-design principles early in the project lifecycle. Support project teams through the design and construction phase , ensuring effective communication of residual risks to contractors. Engage with stakeholders including National Grid, contractors, and multidisciplinary design teams. Monitor and report on CDM compliance and performance , identifying areas for improvement. Promote a strong health, safety, and wellbeing culture across all projects. Skills & Experience Proven experience in a Principal Designer or CDM Advisor role , ideally within the utilities or infrastructure sectors. Strong working knowledge of CDM Regulations 2015 and their practical application. Experience working on National Grid projects and familiarity with SR188 requirements is highly desirable. Demonstrable experience across both FEED/design and construction phases . Ability to lead design risk management activities and influence multidisciplinary teams. Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills. Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Qualifications Relevant degree or equivalent in engineering, construction, or a related discipline. Professional membership (e.g., APS, IOSH, ICE, IET) desirable. NEBOSH Construction Certificate (or equivalent) desirable. Personal Attributes Proactive and solution-oriented mindset. Strong leadership and facilitation skills. High attention to detail with a commitment to safety excellence. Ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams. What We Offer Opportunity to work on critical national infrastructure projects . Exposure to a broad range of FEED and construction stage activities. Competitive salary and benefits package. Professional development and career progression opportunities. Many of the positions within our company are subject to security clearance or security assurance levels. The successful candidate must be able to obtain and maintain the appropriate level of security clearance or assurance level for this role, in line with client and sector requirements. In some cases, additional nationality or residency criteria may also apply due to specific client or national security obligations.
